fact: The Electoral Commission of Namibia's chief electoral officer said registration data would be uploaded to the central server, followed by the Automatic Fingerprint Identification System (AFIS) process and production of the Provisional Voters' Register, after 1,467,604 voters registered by 1 August 2024.

The Electoral Commission of Namibia says voter data captured with biometric Voter Registration Kits is uploaded to a central server, checked for duplicate fingerprints and ID numbers, and stored on a voters roll.
system: Voter Registration Kit biometric voters roll

fact: The Electoral Commission of Namibia used its automated fingerprint information system (Afis) to verify entries on the 2024 voters' register, removing 15,560 duplicate registrations from about 1.4 million voters.
The Namibian reports the final 2024 voters' roll was published and given to political parties to inspect.

The Electoral Commission of Namibia says its custom-made digital biometric voter registration system, in use since 2014, is still effective, and an enhanced Integrated Mobile Voter Registration System began production use for the general registration of voters on 3 June 2024.
